comments.author: Elegant-Tangerine198
comments.body: The first half of the video is the home screen and we see the two female characters changing their face. This is quite interesting. The game visual is unattractive though, with jump animation missing. I hope to see in your next iteration how the two faces connect to the gameplay.

comments.author: No_Toe_7069
comments.body:
this is great! good job making your own art, you've got good skills. did you do the bgm too?

only suggestion are things I'm sure you're already planning for: add some animation frames, tighten up screens and sounds.

really good, you should be proud of yourself. this sort of gameplay is actually pretty simple to code yourself if you wanted to try. you could get most of it done in a single day or 2. Check out this tutorial if you want to try, it's great starting point. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LOhfqjmasi0

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: Its a very good start. I suggest you look at spriters resource to see how to go about making your characters a bit more animated. Also will show you how full spriate sheets are set up. So you have idle. What you currenlty have for walking might be a good idle pose. Then you have jumping sprites, runnign walking. There very simple currently for your animation.  I also suggest maybe looking into like photopea, krita, CSP and other drawing tools so you get ride of some of the 'paint' vibe you have from your art.   It will hlp push your art to another level.  I would also suggest instead of hearts maybe strings or buttons to play off the puppet theme.
